validation_summary.limitations: Synthetic smoke verifies basic result invariants and real interface compatibility only. No accuracy, clinical validity, or all biological use cases are asserted. No large reference databases, model weights, or services were installed or contacted by run_analysis.

review_findings_resolved: MMseqs 18 prefilter rejects the original 1024 MB split budget even for tiny data; default corrected to 4096 MB (index splitting, not full process quota).
MMseqs easy-cluster defaults to soft-linked createdb input; --createdb-mode 0 now copies input into workspace to avoid external artifact symlinks.
RepeatMasker -pa counts parallel batches with 1/2/4 CPU cores per backend; now a separate parallel_batches parameter.
miniprot CDS GFF includes an aligned terminal stop codon; exact coordinate smoke checks this documented behavior.
DIAMOND blastx is a local alignment and may trim matching termini; smoke checks exact identity and >=95% known protein coverage, not false global equality.
Liftoff consumes a prepared feature database and existing FASTA .fai files to avoid writing index/database files beside inputs.
BUSCO receives a local lineage, --offline and --opt-out-run-stats; no automatic lineage download.
Non-commercial licensing of geNomad and CRISPResso2 remains explicit; no upstream algorithm code or data is bundled.
